_comment_header: STATIC VERIFIED WELFARE SCHEMES CONFIG v1.0 - Note: All criteria (income slabs, age limits, occupation categories) must be manually verified against official central/state government gazettes before the eligibility engine uses it live. The system strictly disables LLM inference on eligibility numbers. Missing or non-indexed parameters default to 'Verify manually on official portal'.
verification_source: Official Ministry Gazettes & Citizen Portals (pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, pmaymis.gov.in, pmjay.gov.in, maandhan.in)

schemes.name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
schemes.name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
schemes.target_audience: Urban street vendors, hawkers, thela-walas, vegetable & fruit sellers
schemes.benefit: Working capital collateral-free micro-loans: 1st tranche ₹10,000, 2nd tranche ₹20,000 upon timely repayment, and 3rd tranche ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital transactions up to ₹1,200/year.
schemes.benefit_hi: बिना गारंटी ₹10,000, ₹20,000 और ₹50,000 का आसान कार्यशील ऋण, 7% ब्याज सब्सिडी और ₹1,200/वर्ष तक डिजिटल कैशबैक।

eligibility_criteria.income_max: Verify manually on official portal (No mandatory upper income cap for street vendors holding Vending Certificate)
eligibility_criteria.has_vending_id_or_survey: Holds Certificate of Vending / LOR (Letter of Recommendation) issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)

required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Municipality / TVC Survey slip
schemes.confidence: Verified from MoHUA Official Gazette Guidelines

online_steps: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and click on 'Apply for Loan'.
Enter your mobile number and authenticate via OTP.
Select your Vendor Category (A: Holding CoV/ID, B: Identified in Survey, C: Left out with LOR).
Enter your Aadhaar Number for e-KYC authentication.
Select preferred Lending Institution (Public Bank, Private Bank, or MFI).
Submit application; download the acknowledgment receipt.
offline_steps: Visit your local Urban Local Body (Municipal Corporation / Municipality Office) or Common Service Centre (CSC).
Obtain Letter of Recommendation (LOR) from Town Vending Committee (TVC) if not in survey.
Banking Correspondent (BC) / Municipal Nodal Officer will verify and disburse loan directly to bank account within 7-14 days.

schemes.name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
schemes.name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना (PM-JAY)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (National Health Authority - NHA)
schemes.target_audience: Low-income families, BPL ration card holders, and SECC-deprived households
schemes.benefit: ₹5,00,000 per family per year cashless and paperless hospitalisation cover across all secondary and tertiary empaneled government and private hospitals across India.
schemes.benefit_hi: प्रति परिवार प्रति वर्ष ₹5 लाख तक का पूर्णतः कैशलेस व निःशुल्क अस्पताल इलाज (सरकारी एवं सूचीबद्ध निजी अस्पतालों में)।

eligibility_criteria.age_min: No age limit (Includes all family members)
eligibility_criteria.age_max: No age limit (Senior Citizens 70+ now eligible for standalone ₹5L top-up under Ayushman Vay Vandana)
eligibility_criteria.is_secc_or_bpl: Listed under SECC 2011 Deprivation criteria or State BPL/Antyodaya Ration Database

required_documents: Ration Card (BPL / Antyodaya / State Food Security Card)
schemes.confidence: Verified from National Health Authority Guidelines

online_steps: Visit beneficiary.nha.gov.in and login as 'Beneficiary' using your mobile number and OTP.
Select State, Scheme (PMJAY), and Search By (Aadhaar Number or Ration Card Number / Family ID).
If name appears, click 'e-KYC' and authenticate with Aadhaar OTP or Face Auth.
Upload a clear passport photo and submit.
Upon instant online approval, download your official plastic-ready Ayushman Card PDF.
offline_steps: Visit any nearby Empaneled Government Hospital, Community Health Centre (CHC), or CSC Center.
Meet the 'Ayushman Mitra' desk with your Ration Card and Aadhaar.
Ayushman Mitra will perform biometric authentication and issue your Golden Ayushman Card instantly on the spot.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U / PMAY-G)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) / Ministry of Rural Development
schemes.target_audience: Families without a permanent (pucca) house in EWS, LIG, and Middle Income Groups
schemes.benefit: Direct financial subsidy up to ₹2.50 Lakh for pucca house construction/enhancement or Interest Subsidy Scheme (ISS) of 4.0% - 6.5% on home loans up to ₹35 Lakh under PMAY 2.0.
schemes.benefit_hi: पक्का मकान बनाने हेतु ₹2.5 लाख तक की सीधी सरकारी सहायता या गृह ऋण पर 4.0% से 6.5% तक ब्याज सब्सिडी।
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Self-declaration of not owning any pucca house in India

online_steps: Visit pmaymis.gov.in and click on 'Citizen Assessment' -> 'Apply Online'.
Enter your Aadhaar Number and name as per Aadhaar for e-KYC.
Fill in Household details, present address, monthly family income, and plot/land ownership details.
Select the Component (e.g. Beneficiary Led Construction - BLC or Credit Linked Subsidy - CLSS).
Save and note down the Application Assessment ID.
offline_steps: Visit your local Municipal Corporation / Municipality Office (Awas Yojna Cell) or Gram Panchayat office.
Submit physical PMAY application form with income proof, land paper copy, and bank details.
Municipal engineer will conduct physical geotagging inspection of the plot.
Subsidy is credited directly via DBT in 3-4 construction stage milestones.
how_to_apply.processing_time: 30 to 60 days for geo-verification and state sanction

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY - Small Farmers Pension)
schemes.name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री किसान मान-धन योजना (पीएम-केएमवाई किसान पेंशन)
schemes.target_audience: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land up to 2 hectares (5 acres)
schemes.benefit: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon turning 60 years of age with 50% matching monthly contribution paid by Central Government into LIC-managed pension corpus.
schemes.benefit_hi: 60 वर्ष की आयु के बाद ₹3,000 की मासिक निश्चित पेंशन, केंद्र सरकार द्वारा 50% अंशदान सहयोग के साथ।
required_documents: Savings Bank Account Passbook (IFSC & Account number linked to PM-KISAN)
Khatoni / Land Record (showing cultivable land <= 2 hectares)
schemes.confidence: Verified from Ministry of Agriculture Guidelines

online_steps: Visit maandhan.in and click on 'Enrollment' -> 'Self Enrollment' using your mobile and OTP.
Enter your Aadhaar, Farmer Name, DOB, and PM-KISAN Beneficiary ID (if applicable).
Select auto-debit bank account for monthly contribution (₹55 to ₹200/month based on entry age).
Download and print the auto-debit mandate form, sign it, upload scan, and download your Kisan Pension Card.
offline_steps: Visit your local Common Service Center (CSC / VLE).
Provide Aadhaar card, bank passbook, and land ownership proof.
The VLE will complete biometric authentication and print your laminated PM-KMY Pension Card on the spot.
how_to_apply.fee: Free enrollment at CSC centers (CSC fee borne by Central Govt)
how_to_apply.processing_time: Instant digital enrollment and issuance of Pension Card
